specialities.name: Kova
specialities.why: Rajahmundry is famous for its rich dairy products, and this dense milk-based sweet is a legendary local specialty.

specialities.name: Pootharekulu
specialities.why: Originating from nearby Atreyapuram, this iconic sweet features incredibly thin paper-like rice starch sheets layered generously with ghee and sugar.

specialities.name: Kakinada Kaja
specialities.why: A famous traditional Andhra sweet known for its crispy, flaky exterior and juicy, sugar-syrup-soaked interior.

specialities.name: Godavari boat ride
specialities.why: Taking a cruise on the majestic Godavari River to witness the stunning sunset and bridge views is an unmissable local experience.
